identity.title: Silent Hypoxia in COVID-19: A Case Series

consequential_source_inconsistencies_pre: Results narrative calls Borg CR10 >=5 silent hypoxemia, while Table 2 labels Borg CR10 >=5 as dyspnea.
Results narrative reports OR 0.221 (95% CI 0.054-0.907; p=0.036), while Table 2 reports COVID-19 OR 0.007 (95% CI 0.000-0.199; p=0.004) and pCO2 OR 0.816 (p=0.129).
Results prose says all but one non-COVID-19 patient (98%) had Borg CR10 <5, while Table 2 places 41/42 (98%) COVID-19 patients in the no-dyspnea category.
Discussion states COVID-19 patients had higher dyspnea sensation, conflicting with the abstract, Results, Figure 1, and conclusion showing lower dyspnea ratings in COVID-19.
notes: No contradiction was silently normalized into a single preferred estimate or group label.
